capability: Grants an application the ability to programmatically manage, query, or modify cellular plans (e.g., eSIMs, physical SIMs, data plans, voice plans) on the device. This includes operations such as adding, removing, activating, deactivating, or switching between cellular plans, as well as retrieving detailed information about these plans (e.g., ICCID, phone number, carrier details, data usage status).
